Captured 2026-10-09 from development Linux x86_64 workstation, kernel 7.0.0-34-generic, Intel Core i7-13700K. These are parser fixtures, not physical-machine qualification evidence.
cpuinfo.txt: exact first processor stanza, /proc/cpuinfo lines 1-28. Other processors deliberately excluded; expected one logical and physical core in this sample.
meminfo.txt: /proc/meminfo lines 1-18, unchanged bytes, includes total/available/swap measurements.
modules.txt: /proc/modules lines 1-3, unchanged bytes. Remaining modules deliberately excluded; expected count three.
sys/class/dmi/id/chassis_type: entire sysfs file, unchanged bytes.
sys/class/power_supply/ucsi-source-psy-USBC000:001/type: entire sysfs file, unchanged bytes. The other USB supply excluded; fixture intentionally contains no battery.
Inline JSON in tests is adversarial/constructed native-format evidence, not a claim of capture. EFI fixtures deliberately vary attribute/value bytes to test binary parsing and absence/permission semantics; no Secure Boot hardware qualification claimed.
snap-ubuntu24-empty.json: exact 79-byte GET /v2/snaps response (no trailing newline) captured 2026-10-10 via SSH from enrolled Ubuntu 24.04 VM lindm-ubuntu-real, device abeb1aaf-d2ac-4c1f-9ad1-8fcd1e7e2035. Command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 10 --unix-socket /run/snapd.socket http://localhost/v2/snaps. HTTP 200, Content-Type application/json. Installed/active snapd has zero installed snaps; snap list exits zero with empty stdout and a human-readable stderr notice. REST supplies successful empty-list evidence without interpreting that CLI diagnostic. This fixture is native parser regression evidence, not physical qualification.
storage/ubuntu24-transient-lsblk.json: exact lsblk --json --bytes --tree --output NAME,KNAME,TYPE,SIZE,FSTYPE,FSVER,UUID,PARTUUID,PARTTYPE,TRAN,MODEL,SERIAL,WWN,REV,MOUNTPOINTS,PKNAME output captured 2026-10-10 from the enrolled encrypted Ubuntu24.04 VM, lindm-demo-encrypted virtio-blk disk, inside a short-lived systemd unit with PrivateDevices=no, DevicePolicy=closed, DeviceAllow=block-* r, empty CapabilityBoundingSet/AmbientCapabilities, PrivateNetwork=yes, ProtectSystem=strict and private tmp. Native lsblk exits0 without stderr and includes dm_crypt-0 plus ubuntu--vg-ubuntu--lv rooted at /. The persistent executor's PrivateDevices=yes view omitted both mapper nodes; this fixture preserves their full native graph. Separate same-policy cryptsetup luksDump --dump-json-metadata succeeded with1 keyslot/0 tokens; secret-bearing header JSON was discarded, not stored. Both diagnostic units were collected. This is VM regression evidence, not physical qualification.
